** Minor** · **Functional Correctness** · **Quick win** **Do not silently omit a resolved zero limit.** If a caller sets `max_tokens=300` and `max_completion_tokens=0`, the resolver selects zero, but this guard omits `inferenceConfig.maxTokens`. The request then loses the explicit output limit. Check `is not None` here, and reject zero explicitly if Bedrock requires a positive limit. The public completion path constructs `CompletionParams` from both values without a positivity check. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/bbda53fa0d07d9f93d1b494558b894308df115bd/src/any_llm/any_llm.py))

If Bedrock requires a positive maxTokens value, reject zero explicitly before building the request. After applying the fix, consider running `coderabbit review --agent` for local review. Visit https://docs.coderabbit.ai/cli?utm_source=ghpr ```

** Trivial** · **Maintainability & Code Quality** · **Quick win** **Keep each provider's tests runnable without the other optional SDKs.** If `mistralai` is absent, the module-level skip also suppresses Anthropic, Gemini and Bedrock tests. The same applies to either of the other optional SDKs. Parameterise provider availability independently so an installed provider remains tested. The manifest declares these SDKs as separate optional extras. ([raw.githubusercontent.com](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mozilla-ai/any-llm/bbda53fa0d07d9f93d1b494558b894308df115bd/pyproject.toml))
